title: suggestions-service: add read APIs for Suggestions (list + detail) with tenant scoping + basic filters
author: Felix Schneider
description:
Implements the initial read-only Suggestions API surface for the Suggestions beta. This PR adds two endpoints backed by the suggestions-service (within the monorepo service boundary) and wires auth/tenant scoping so Console can safely list and fetch details without cross-tenant leakage.

Endpoints:
- GET /v1/optimize/suggestions
  - Supports basic filtering by route_id, model, region, suggestion_type, and risk_level
  - Default sort: estimated_monthly_savings_usd DESC, then updated_at DESC
  - Returns a stable server-generated id per suggestion (opaque string) + minimal list fields for the table view
- GET /v1/optimize/suggestions/{id}
  - Returns the full suggestion payload (basis/rationale + savings estimate + risk info)

Tenant scoping + auth:
- Resolves tenant/workspace from the auth context (no tenant id in query params)
- Enforces RBAC permission optimize:suggestions:read
- Adds an explicit guard that suggestion.id lookups are constrained to the same workspace_id

Notes / non-goals:
- No pagination yet (follow-up will add cursor pagination once we validate payload size + UI needs)
- Savings estimation and risk scoring are stubbed as pass-through fields where present; this PR does not implement the computation pipeline
- Error handling includes explicit 404 for unknown id, 403 for missing permission, and 503 when suggestion store is unavailable

Testing:
- Unit tests for filter parsing + workspace scoping
- Integration tests for list/detail auth behavior (403/404/200)

Refs: ENG-2402. Console integration will land behind suggestions_beta feature flag in a separate PR.
commits: suggestions-service: add suggestion store interface + query filters
authz: enforce optimize:suggestions:read and workspace scoping
review_conversation: Chloe Martin (review): Can you confirm we never accept workspace/tenant from the request query/body? We had a previous incident with accidental tenant override via query params.

Felix Schneider (author): Confirmed. Workspace is derived exclusively from auth context (ctx.workspaceId). I also added an explicit WHERE workspace_id = $ctx.workspaceId constraint to both list + detail queries, and a test that ensures a valid id from a different workspace returns 404.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): For the detail endpoint, please avoid returning raw internal identifiers (route numeric ids) unless they are already exposed in Console. Also, can we ensure the response does not include any prompt text or customer content from telemetry?

Felix Schneider (author): Good call. I removed internal route_pk and replaced it with route_id (public id already used in Console routes UI). No prompt text is included; the payload contains aggregate telemetry basis (counts / windows) only. Added a small redaction test to ensure basis does not accept freeform strings.
Ethan Park (review): Slight concern with 503 behavior: the handler currently maps store timeouts to 500. Can you translate store timeout/unavailable into 503 so Console can render a retry state?
Felix Schneider (author): Updated error mapping: store unavailable/timeout -> 503 with retryAfter=5 header. Added integration test coverage.

Logan Wright (review): Filters: can we cap lookback window in list endpoint? If clients request huge windows we’ll end up scanning a lot. Even if we’re not implementing full pagination yet, guardrails would help.

Felix Schneider (author): Implemented a max lookback of 30d (default 7d) for list queries; requests beyond 30d are clamped and we return a warning header X-Redwood-Warn: lookback_clamped. Added docs in the route comment. We can revisit once we add cursor pagination + precomputed rollups.
Chloe Martin (review): LGTM after the 503 mapping and the 404 cross-workspace test.
Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): Approved after redaction changes.
release_notes: Internal: Adds read-only Suggestions API endpoints (list + detail) with RBAC + tenant scoping for Console Suggestions beta.
